title: Pablo G. Baretto
text: I help mid-market companies adopt AI without assuming a fixed reference architecture stack, perfect data governance, or a specific vendor. I start from each company’s in-house capacity, privacy constraints, cost shape, existing IT-vendor agreements, and cloud footprint, then design and implement an AI stack that fits. As a result, adoption is low-risk, affordable, secure, scalable, and they take it on in stages.

title: Pablo G. Baretto
text:

title: Pablo G. Baretto
text:
Pablo G. Baretto here.
You might need more than ChatGPT or Claude if you want your company to embrace AI. You need an AI stack that makes those models useful for your company’s reality. Since there is no single AI stack that fits every company, the stack you need should be built from proven, reliable components, chosen according to your in-house capacity and skills, privacy constraints, cost structure, existing IT-vendor agreements and cloud footprint.
I implement AI stacks for mid-size companies using lessons from past mistakes: low and controlled risk, scalability and security from day one, a staged rollout, and a preference for assembling existing production-grade components over custom development when possible.
I’m a solutions architect and data engineer with 20+ years of experience and several successful cases building production AI apps and AI stacks for companies.
Ask me what I’d put in your stack
